en: Psalms 68
For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. A song.

ja: 指揮者のために。ダビデの詩。歌。

p.src: 1  Let God arise! Let his enemies be scattered! Let them who hate him also flee before him.

ja: がられますように。 その
en: Let God arise! Let his enemies be scattered! Let them who hate him also flee before him.
u.src: 1  Let God arise! Let his enemies be scattered! Let them who hate him also flee before him.

p.src: 2  As smoke is driven away, so drive them away. As wax melts before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.

ja: き飛ばしてください。 ろうが
en: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away. As wax melts before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.
u.src: 2  As smoke is driven away, so drive them away. As wax melts before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.

p.src: 3  But let the righteous be glad. Let them rejoice before God. Yes, let them rejoice with gladness.

ja: びにあふれますように。
en: But let the righteous be glad. Let them rejoice before God. Yes, let them rejoice with gladness.
u.src: 3  But let the righteous be glad. Let them rejoice before God. Yes, let them rejoice with gladness.

p.src: 4  Sing to God! Sing praises to his name! Extol him who rides on the clouds: to the LORD, his name! Rejoice before him!

ja: をほめたたえよ。 主 がその御
en: Sing to God! Sing praises to his name! Extol him who rides on the clouds: to the LORD, his name! Rejoice before him!
u.src: 4  Sing to God! Sing praises to his name! Extol him who rides on the clouds: to the LORD, his name! Rejoice before him!

ja: 68:4 ヘブル語ではיה（ヤハ）である。
en: 68:4 Hebrew: יה Yah

p.src: 5  A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.

ja: 父なし子の父、やもめの擁護者は、
まいにおられる神である。
en: A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.
u.src: 5  A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.

p.src: 6  God sets the lonely in families. He brings out the prisoners with singing, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.

ja: に家族を与え、 捕らわれ人を歌いながら連れ出される。 しかし、背く
たちは太陽に焼かれた
en: God sets the lonely in families. He brings out the prisoners with singing, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.
u.src: 6  God sets the lonely in families. He brings out the prisoners with singing, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.

p.src: 7  God, when you went out before your people, when you marched through the wilderness... Selah.

en: God, when you went out before your people, when you marched through the wilderness... Selah.
u.src: 7  God, when you went out before your people, when you marched through the wilderness... Selah.

p.src: 8  The earth trembled. The sky also poured down rain at the presence of the God of Sinai— at the presence of God, the God of Israel.

ja: は震えた。 シナイの
らせた。 神、イスラエルの
en: The earth trembled. The sky also poured down rain at the presence of the God of Sinai— at the presence of God, the God of Israel.
u.src: 8  The earth trembled. The sky also poured down rain at the presence of the God of Sinai— at the presence of God, the God of Israel.

p.src: 9  You, God, sent a plentiful rain. You confirmed your inheritance when it was weary.

ja: を注がれた。 あなたの相続地が
れたとき、これを回復された。
en: You, God, sent a plentiful rain. You confirmed your inheritance when it was weary.
u.src: 9  You, God, sent a plentiful rain. You confirmed your inheritance when it was weary.

p.src: 10  Your congregation lived therein. You, God, prepared your goodness for the poor.

ja: よ、あなたは良いものを
en: Your congregation lived therein. You, God, prepared your goodness for the poor.
u.src: 10  Your congregation lived therein. You, God, prepared your goodness for the poor.

p.src: 11  The Lord announced the word. The ones who proclaim it are a great company.

ja: はみことばを告げられた。 これを告げ
en: The Lord announced the word. The ones who proclaim it are a great company.
u.src: 11  The Lord announced the word. The ones who proclaim it are a great company.

p.src: 12  “Kings of armies flee! They flee!” She who waits at home divides the plunder,

en: “Kings of armies flee! They flee!” She who waits at home divides the plunder,
u.src: 12  “Kings of armies flee! They flee!” She who waits at home divides the plunder,

p.src: 13  while you sleep among the camp fires, the wings of a dove sheathed with silver, her feathers with shining gold.

ja: あなたがたがたき火の
たわっている間にも、 鳩の翼は
en: while you sleep among the camp fires, the wings of a dove sheathed with silver, her feathers with shining gold.
u.src: 13  while you sleep among the camp fires, the wings of a dove sheathed with silver, her feathers with shining gold.

p.src: 14  When the Almighty scattered kings in her, it snowed on Zalmon.

ja: らされたとき、 ザルモンには
en: When the Almighty scattered kings in her, it snowed on Zalmon.
u.src: 14  When the Almighty scattered kings in her, it snowed on Zalmon.

p.src: 15  The mountains of Bashan are majestic mountains. The mountains of Bashan are rugged.

en: The mountains of Bashan are majestic mountains. The mountains of Bashan are rugged.
u.src: 15  The mountains of Bashan are majestic mountains. The mountains of Bashan are rugged.

p.src: 16  Why do you look in envy, you rugged mountains, at the mountain where God chooses to reign? Yes, the LORD will dwell there forever.

ja: るのか。 神が住まいとして選ばれた山を。 まことに、主はそこに
en: Why do you look in envy, you rugged mountains, at the mountain where God chooses to reign? Yes, the LORD will dwell there forever.
u.src: 16  Why do you look in envy, you rugged mountains, at the mountain where God chooses to reign? Yes, the LORD will dwell there forever.

en: 68:16 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

p.src: 17  The chariots of God are tens of thousands and thousands of thousands. The Lord is among them, from Sinai, into the sanctuary.

en: The chariots of God are tens of thousands and thousands of thousands. The Lord is among them, from Sinai, into the sanctuary.
u.src: 17  The chariots of God are tens of thousands and thousands of thousands. The Lord is among them, from Sinai, into the sanctuary.

p.src: 18  You have ascended on high. You have led away captives. You have received gifts among people, yes, among the rebellious also, that the LORD God might dwell there.

en: You have ascended on high. You have led away captives. You have received gifts among people, yes, among the rebellious also, that the LORD God might dwell there.
u.src: 18  You have ascended on high. You have led away captives. You have received gifts among people, yes, among the rebellious also, that the LORD God might dwell there.

ja: 68:18 ヘブル語ではיה（ヤハ）である。
en: 68:18 Hebrew: יה Yah

p.src: 19  Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation. Selah.

ja: が、ほめたたえられますように。 セラ。
en: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation. Selah.
u.src: 19  Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation. Selah.

p.src: 20  God is to us a God of deliverance. To GOD, the Lord, belongs escape from death.

en: God is to us a God of deliverance. To GOD, the Lord, belongs escape from death.
u.src: 20  God is to us a God of deliverance. To GOD, the Lord, belongs escape from death.

en: 68:20 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

p.src: 21  But God will strike through the head of his enemies, the hairy scalp of such a one as still continues in his guiltiness.

en: But God will strike through the head of his enemies, the hairy scalp of such a one as still continues in his guiltiness.
u.src: 21  But God will strike through the head of his enemies, the hairy scalp of such a one as still continues in his guiltiness.

p.src: 22  The Lord said, “I will bring you again from Bashan, I will bring you again from the depths of the sea,

ja: われた。「私は彼らをバシャンから
en: The Lord said, “I will bring you again from Bashan, I will bring you again from the depths of the sea,
u.src: 22  The Lord said, “I will bring you again from Bashan, I will bring you again from the depths of the sea,

p.src: 23  that you may crush them, dipping your foot in blood, that the tongues of your dogs may have their portion from your enemies.”

ja: あなたが彼らを打ち砕き、
が敵から分け前を得るためである。」
en: that you may crush them, dipping your foot in blood, that the tongues of your dogs may have their portion from your enemies.”
u.src: 23  that you may crush them, dipping your foot in blood, that the tongues of your dogs may have their portion from your enemies.”

p.src: 24  They have seen your processions, God, even the processions of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.

en: They have seen your processions, God, even the processions of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.
u.src: 24  They have seen your processions, God, even the processions of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.

p.src: 25  The singers went before, the minstrels followed after, among the ladies playing with tambourines,

ja: いた。 タンバリンを鳴らす
en: The singers went before, the minstrels followed after, among the ladies playing with tambourines,
u.src: 25  The singers went before, the minstrels followed after, among the ladies playing with tambourines,

p.src: 26  “Bless God in the congregations, even the Lord in the assembly of Israel!”

ja: をほめたたえよ。 イスラエルの集会で
en: “Bless God in the congregations, even the Lord in the assembly of Israel!”
u.src: 26  “Bless God in the congregations, even the Lord in the assembly of Israel!”

p.src: 27  There is little Benjamin, their ruler, the princes of Judah, their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.

ja: さなベニヤミンが彼らを率い、 ユダの
主たちとその一団、 ゼブルンの
en: There is little Benjamin, their ruler, the princes of Judah, their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.
u.src: 27  There is little Benjamin, their ruler, the princes of Judah, their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.

p.src: 28  Your God has commanded your strength. Strengthen, God, that which you have done for us.

ja: たちのためになされたことを
en: Your God has commanded your strength. Strengthen, God, that which you have done for us.
u.src: 28  Your God has commanded your strength. Strengthen, God, that which you have done for us.

p.src: 29  Because of your temple at Jerusalem, kings will bring presents to you.

ja: エルサレムにあるあなたの宮のゆえに、
en: Because of your temple at Jerusalem, kings will bring presents to you.
u.src: 29  Because of your temple at Jerusalem, kings will bring presents to you.

p.src: 30  Rebuke the wild animal of the reeds, the multitude of the bulls with the calves of the peoples. Trample under foot the bars of silver. Scatter the nations who delight in war.

ja: を叱りつけてください。 雄牛の
たちを。 銀の棒を踏みにじってください。
en: Rebuke the wild animal of the reeds, the multitude of the bulls with the calves of the peoples. Trample under foot the bars of silver. Scatter the nations who delight in war.
u.src: 30  Rebuke the wild animal of the reeds, the multitude of the bulls with the calves of the peoples. Trample under foot the bars of silver. Scatter the nations who delight in war.

p.src: 31  Princes shall come out of Egypt. Ethiopia shall hurry to stretch out her hands to God.

ja: エジプトから君主たちが
en: Princes shall come out of Egypt. Ethiopia shall hurry to stretch out her hands to God.
u.src: 31  Princes shall come out of Egypt. Ethiopia shall hurry to stretch out her hands to God.

p.src: 32  Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth! Sing praises to the Lord—Selah—

en: Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth! Sing praises to the Lord—Selah—
u.src: 32  Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth! Sing praises to the Lord—Selah—

p.src: 33  to him who rides on the heaven of heavens, which are of old; behold, he utters his voice, a mighty voice.

en: to him who rides on the heaven of heavens, which are of old; behold, he utters his voice, a mighty voice.
u.src: 33  to him who rides on the heaven of heavens, which are of old; behold, he utters his voice, a mighty voice.

p.src: 34  Ascribe strength to God! His excellency is over Israel, his strength is in the skies.

en: Ascribe strength to God! His excellency is over Israel, his strength is in the skies.
u.src: 34  Ascribe strength to God! His excellency is over Israel, his strength is in the skies.

p.src: 35  You are awesome, God, in your sanctuaries. The God of Israel gives strength and power to his people. Praise be to God!

ja: である。 イスラエルの
がほめたたえられますように。
en: You are awesome, God, in your sanctuaries. The God of Israel gives strength and power to his people. Praise be to God!
u.src: 35  You are awesome, God, in your sanctuaries. The God of Israel gives strength and power to his people. Praise be to God!
